dialog.body: Public Works storm line, this is Kevin.

Hi Kevin, yeah, this is Doug Hazard, I'm calling about the building I own at 395 Memorial Boulevard, over by Easton's Beach, and I know it's Sunday and City Hall's closed so I'm glad somebody picks up this line, but the thing is the parking lot behind the building slopes right toward the back door, and every time we get a real storm like the one Friday into Saturday the drain back there can't keep up and the water just pools and runs straight into the entrance, and yesterday it came right over the threshold into the back hallway, and my tenants had to wade in with their groceries, and this keeps happening, I've called about that drain before and nothing changes, so I'm kind of at the end of my rope here.

Okay, got it. So 395 Memorial Boulevard, back lot, water running to the rear door after the storm yesterday. Let me jot that down. Was it the storm drain in the lot itself that's clogged, or is it more that the lot just doesn't drain?

Honestly both, I think, there's a grate at the low spot and it's packed with sand and leaves and junk from the beach side, and even when it's clear the pitch of the lot sends everything toward the door, so yesterday it was standing water about, I don't know, two inches deep right up against the door and then it came inside, and I mopped for an hour and a half, and it's the same thing every big rain, so I want somebody to actually come look at it and not just write it down again.
Understood. Is the water still there this morning, or has it gone down?

It's mostly gone down but there's still a big puddle at the grate and the hallway carpet is soaked, I took a bunch of photos yesterday while it was happening, the water at the door, the grate full of debris, I can send those to you if you give me somewhere to send them.

Yeah, that'd help. [pause] Let me see, I can take an email address for the department, hang on, I'll have to get that to you. Actually, let me put it in the ticket that you have photos, and someone from the office will follow up with where to send them. Is this number you're calling from good?
Yeah, it's a cell, so if it cuts out call me back, it's 401-555-0153.
Four-oh-one, five-five-five, oh-one-five-three. Got it. And you said you've called about this before?

I mean, I've mentioned it, yeah, in the fall, I think, and somebody said they'd put it on a list, and then this storm hit and here we are again, so you can see why I'm a little fed up, because I've got tenants asking me what I'm doing about it and the answer is I keep calling the city.
Yeah, I hear you. I don't see the older notes from where I'm sitting on the weekend line, but I'll make sure this one's flagged as a repeat so it doesn't get lost.
Okay. Um, one thing, do the crews work weekends? Because I'd love for somebody to come clear that grate today or tomorrow before the next round of rain.

They do get called out on weekends after a storm, but they're stretched thin right now with everything that came down Friday and Saturday, so I can't tell you a time. Storm-related drain stuff usually gets prioritized, so I'll mark it as a blocked drain with water entering a building.
Alright. Hold on one sec, [pause] sorry, I've got a casserole in the oven that needs about ten more minutes, so I do have to keep an ear on that, but go ahead.

No problem, don't burn dinner. I've got the address, the back lot, grate packed with debris, lot pitches toward the rear door, water got inside, photos available. Anything else I should add? Any way for the crew to get into the lot?

Yeah, there's an alley off the side street, you can drive right in, it's not gated, they can't miss it, it's the lot behind the building with the dumpster, and the grate's right in the middle toward the back door.

Perfect. Alley access, dumpster, grate near the back door. I'll send that over to the supervisor first thing, and the office should reach out Monday about those photos and about the lot grading, since that might be a separate question from just cleaning the drain.
Okay, that's fair. I just want somebody to come out and actually see it this time, that's all I'm asking, because I'm tired of mopping.
Yep, understood. You'll get a call back on that cell. Anything else for today?
No, that's it. Thanks, Kevin. I've gotta go get that casserole.
Sounds good, Doug. Take care.
